newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FAN LEAVES DUTCH CLUB LIFE'S SAVINGS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FAN LEAVES DUTCH CLUB LIFE'S SAVINGS.

text.p: Homesick Alie Naafs bequeathed Dutch side Twente Enschede her life's savings, Dutch newspaper Algemeen Dagblad reported on Tuesday.
Naafs, who died in April aged 88, left the first division club 15,000 guilders ($7,800).
A resident of Wolvega in northern Netherlands, she missed her birthplace of Enschede and followed Twente closely, although she never attended a match.
